picks.headline: Unit 42's AI system discovers over 14,000 open-source zero-day vulnerabilities
picks.why: Demonstrates the practical scale of AI-automated vulnerability discovery across software supply chains.
picks.title: The Frontier AI Vulnerability Burst: Industrializing Autonomous Zero-Day Discovery in Open-Source Software

picks.headline: Shared Claude chats indexed by Google Search, exposing private credentials
picks.why: Exposes severe privacy leakage where shared conversation URLs were scraped and publicly indexed.
picks.title: Some Claude Chats Are Searchable on Google

picks.headline: NVIDIA open-sources cuFile APIs and launches Storage-Next for GPU storage
picks.why: Establishes open standards for direct GPU-to-storage data access, addressing memory bottlenecks for AI workloads.
picks.title: As AI Increases Demands on Memory, Storage Steps Up

picks.headline: Report details nine AI coding agent incidents causing catastrophic data deletion
picks.why: Highlights systemic guardrail failures in popular autonomous coding agents like Cursor and Claude.
picks.title: Nine AI coding agent incidents that ended with deleted data

picks.headline: AWS launches native Web Search tool for Amazon Bedrock model grounding
picks.why: Provides managed, server-side web grounding using Amazon's proprietary search index directly inside Bedrock.
picks.title: Introducing Web Search on Amazon Bedrock for foundation model grounding

picks.headline: Study finds increased reasoning effort in GPT-5.6 does not raise tool violations
picks.why: Reassures developers that test-time scaling in reasoning models does not inherently degrade tool safety compliance.
picks.title: Test-time reasoning effort and unauthorized tool use in language-model agents: a prespecified equivalence study

papers.why: Allows smaller and larger models in a family to share KV caches without re-computing prefill steps, significantly cutting latency.
papers.title: Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer in LLM Families: A Closed-Form Linear Mapping for Prefill Reuse

papers.headline: Standardized test-time scaling framework released alongside two billion reasoning traces
papers.why: Unifies inference-time compute scaling methodologies and provides a massive open dataset for studying model reasoning behavior.
papers.title: Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility

papers.headline: Autoregressive diffusion model achieves real-time 720p video editing on single GPU
papers.why: Enables 30 FPS streamable video editing without needing future frame context or heavy offline rendering pipelines.
papers.title: JoyAI-Video-Edit: Real-Time Open-Ended Video Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
